provenance.instrument: Code of the Township of Hempfield (Westmoreland County), Chapter 87 Zoning, as published on eCode360, with Tables 1 to 4 as attachments
provenance.status_detail: eCode360: includes legislation through 03-23-2026 (Supp 74, Mar 2026). New Laws (2) listed, not opened. Table 1 and Table 3 amended 3-23-2026 by Ord. No. 2026-03. eCode360 is Cloudflare-walled for plain fetches. Text and table PDFs were read in a browser.
provenance.code_current_through_note: Includes legislation through 03-23-2026. New Laws (2) not yet codified.
checks: The accessory apartment rule (87-79) sits in Article XV, the TND Traditional Neighborhood Development Overlay (TC-R and TC-B). The Table of Uses has no accessory apartment row. Outside the TND overlay no ADU path is written
Special exception from the Zoning Hearing Board. One apartment within a single-family dwelling, one bedroom, more than 400 sq ft, at most 35% of the livable floor area (87-79A)
The owner must live in one of the two units. The other unit may only be occupied by a person related by blood or marriage to the owner (87-79A(11), (12))
No garage or portion of a garage may be used for or converted to a residential use (87-17G(1))

Table 2 lists 'Quarters separate from the principal dwelling (caretaker's quarters)' as a permitted accessory use in A, RR, TC-R, NC and BT. The code text gives no standards or definition for it. Ask the Zoning Officer whether it can serve as a second dwelling
Sewage and water adequacy must be certified, and the Municipal Authority must accept the added sewage demand (87-79A(6) to (8))
Exterior stairs may not face a street (87-79A(9))
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Planning and Zoning, https://www.hempfieldtwp.com/162/Planning-Zoning. Pending: New Laws (2) on eCode360 were not opened. A March 2026 news headline mentions proposed zoning changes. Not checked against an ordinance. Not law.

term.note: '§ 87-79. Accessory apartments.' 87-75 also uses 'accessory dwelling units' for TND density counting.

status.note: Special exception. The non-owner unit 'may only be occupied by a person who is related by blood or marriage to such owner(s).'

path.note: 'A special exception is required to create a single apartment within a single-family dwelling'. Zoning Hearing Board.

fallback_path.note: Reading: outside the TND overlay, or for a detached unit, a second dwelling is not a listed use. The path is a use variance.

zoning_districts.note: 87-79 is in Article XV, the TND overlay (TC-R and TC-B). The overlay covers parcels listed in TND Exhibit A (87-71). Reading: the rule applies only there.

building_types.note: Text says 'within a single-family dwelling'. 87-75 speaks of a single-family detached dwelling unit.

existing_structure_only.note: Text does not say whether the house must already exist.

types_allowed.note: 'a single apartment within a single-family dwelling'. Garages may not be used for or converted to residential use (87-17G(1)).

max_sqft.note: No square foot cap in 87-79. Only the 35% share. 87-75 exempts ADUs of 400 to 1,200 sq ft from TND density counts.

max_share_of_house.note: 'shall not exceed 35% of the entire livable gross floor area of the single-family dwelling.'

min_sqft.note: 'The gross floor area of the apartment shall be greater than 400 square feet.'

max_height_ft.note: Accessory structures: building height 20 feet in A, RR, SR, CR and VR. ADU itself must be inside the house.

setback_front_ft.note: Accessory structures 'Shall not be constructed any closer to the front yard line than the front of the principal building'.

setback_side_ft.note: SR accessory structures: side yard 10 feet. A and RR 25 ft, CR and VR 5 ft. See districts.

setback_rear_ft.note: SR accessory structures: rear yard 10 feet. A and RR 35 ft, CR and VR 10 ft.

separation_ft.note: No separation between buildings on one lot found in 87-17.

internal_uses_district_height.note: Unit is inside the house, so the district height (35 ft) applies.

owner_occupancy.note: 'The owner(s) of a property on which there is an accessory apartment must occupy one of the two residential units on the property.'

family_only.note: 'may only be occupied by a person who is related by blood or marriage to such owner(s).'

max_adus.note: 'Only one apartment is allowed and it shall be clearly subordinate to the single-family dwelling.'

spaces_required.note: 'Off-street parking shall be on the parcel on which the accessory apartment is located.' No number in 87-79. Article XXI table not read.

new_connection_required.note: Water and sewage must be certified adequate for two units. Separate connections not addressed.

min_lot_sqft.note: SR single-family detached. Principal yards: front 30 ft, side 10 ft, rear 15 ft.

setback_front_ft.note: District front yard. An accessory structure may not be closer to the front lot line than the front of the house (Table 4).

setback_side_ft.note: Table 4 accessory structures, SR: side yard 10 feet. Principal side yard is in Table 3.

setback_rear_ft.note: Table 4 accessory structures, SR: rear yard 10 feet.

min_lot_sqft.note: RR single-family detached with utilities. Principal yards: front 30 ft, side 25 ft, rear 35 ft.

setback_front_ft.note: District front yard. An accessory structure may not be closer to the front lot line than the front of the house (Table 4).

setback_side_ft.note: Table 4 accessory structures, RR: side yard 25 feet. Principal side yard is in Table 3.

setback_rear_ft.note: Table 4 accessory structures, RR: rear yard 35 feet.

min_lot_sqft.note: A single-family detached with utilities. Principal yards: front 30 ft, side 25 ft, rear 35 ft.

setback_front_ft.note: District front yard. An accessory structure may not be closer to the front lot line than the front of the house (Table 4).

setback_side_ft.note: Table 4 accessory structures, A: side yard 25 feet. Principal side yard is in Table 3.

setback_rear_ft.note: Table 4 accessory structures, A: rear yard 35 feet.

min_lot_sqft.note: VR single-family detached. Front yard is the average of adjoining lots. Side 10 ft, rear 15 ft.

setback_side_ft.note: Table 4 accessory structures, CR and VR: side yard 5 feet. Principal side yard is in Table 3.

setback_rear_ft.note: Table 4 accessory structures, CR and VR: rear yard 10 feet.
